findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "add_project_item" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: project_id, section, name, store, price, link, notes, photo_url, fields, code, goes, option, cart_id

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: confirm_facts, maintenance_tickets, mark_no_show, update_maintenance_ticket · Private data: upload_file, request_go_live, upload_report, drop_link, ask_us, project, start_project_picture, finish_project_picture, remove_project_picture, update_project_item, companies, create_group, update_group · Public sink: set_company, upload_file, upload_report, submit_facts, confirm_facts, drop_link, change_stay_rate, chat_groups, post_to_chat_group, update_project, start_project_picture, finish_project_picture, update_project_picture, add_project_item, update_project_item, change_reservation · Destructive: drop_link, remove_stay_from_group, remove_project_picture, night_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: confirm_facts, maintenance_tickets, mark_no_show, update_maintenance_ticket · Private data: upload_file, request_go_live, upload_report, drop_link, ask_us, project, start_project_picture, finish_project_picture, remove_project_picture, update_project_item, companies, create_group, update_group · Public sink: set_company, upload_file, upload_report, submit_facts, confirm_facts, drop_link, change_stay_rate, chat_groups, post_to_chat_group, update_project, start_project_picture, finish_project_picture, update_project_picture, add_project_item, update_project_item, change_reservation · Destructive: drop_link, remove_stay_from_group, remove_project_picture, night_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
